title: 第九章阴谋现巫族上门第十章鸡来了提点一下
slug: 洪荒走向神话的大天尊
content_zh:
没过多长时间，洪荒天地之间，天庭为洪荒秩序管理之所的消息就传扬了出去，尤其是巫妖残余所在之地。
没错，就是阐教某人的杰作。
某日，一队人马向着天庭方向急速逼近。
这些人各个身强体健，身形壮硕无比。
尤其是为首那人，身高九丈，每一寸肌肤都闪烁着玄奥纹路，仔细看去，竟是某种大道法则被生生刻录于肉身之上。
他两手各持一柄大斧、一面巨盾，气势威猛，恍若战神临世。
正是曾经名震洪荒、上代量劫主角之一的巫族余部。
后方一名巫族抬头望了望天色，又看了看周围同伴，脸上浮现出一抹犹豫，终于忍不住开口：
“刑天大哥，我等今日前来攻打天庭，可是有些不妥？”
刑天闻言，顿时皱起眉头。
巫妖量劫方过，巫族族人几近灭绝，十二祖巫尽数陨落。此时正是休养生息之际，他何尝不知？
然则他听闻消息，紫霄宫的童子昊天被立为新天帝。若只是如此，倒也罢了。巫族向来与天庭无甚瓜葛，谁当天帝原也不放在心上。
可那昊天竟放言，天庭乃洪荒秩序管理之所。那岂不就是说，天庭要统御整个洪荒？
这如何能行？置巫族于何地？
是以刑天马不停蹄，当即带人前来攻打。一则欲占据天庭，为巫族寻一处合适的休养生息之地。
二则更是为了重振巫族威名。他要让洪荒众生都知道——巫族并未真正灭亡！
他刑天所作所为，皆是为了巫族。
未料竟还有人对此抱有疑问。
不过巫族所剩无几，他亦未动怒，只反问道：“凤伯，有何不妥？”
凤伯亦是巫族大巫之一，只是战力远不如刑天。他硬着头皮道：“十二祖巫已陨，巫族如今最强之人便是大巫你。万一你再发生意外，巫族今后又该何去何从？

再者，那昊天乃鸿钧道祖亲自敕封，贸然攻打，终有不妥。
依我之见，咱们应当先往幽冥，问过后土祖巫的意思再作计较。”
这话甚是有理，旁边几位大巫纷纷点头附和。
十二祖巫已死，若刑天再出事，巫族还有什么指望？只怕覆灭之日便在眼前。
况且昊天方受鸿钧之命来到洪荒，若被他们杀了，岂不是要得罪道祖？众人实在不愿攻打天庭。
刑天见众人忧心忡忡，忍不住嗤笑一声。
“那昊天小儿，不过区区一童子，竟也敢坐天帝之位？简直是天大的笑话！”他声如洪钟，震得虚空嗡嗡作响，“想那妖族乃我巫族所灭，天庭自当归巫族入主。若非鸿钧亲命，岂能轮到他捡这便宜？天庭，当属巫族！”
事实上，这不止是刑天的想法，亦是洪荒众生的心声。
天庭之位何其重要？各方势力无不觊觎，皆想称霸洪荒、登临天帝。
龙凤麒麟三族、巫妖二族，乃至东王公，皆曾以身家性命搏杀争抢。可昊天呢？什么都不曾做，只凭道祖一纸敕封，便坐上了那至高无上的位置。众人心中岂能没有想法？
只不过众生皆惧鸿钧道祖之威，不敢轻举妄动罢了。
巫族族人们自然也明白这个道理。可事情哪有那么简单？
“大巫切莫小瞧了昊天与瑶池。”凤伯又道，“他们既是鸿钧童子，想来也有几分本事。据传言，鸿钧曾赐予二人宝物，威力莫大，不可不防。”
content_en:
It didn't take long for the news to spread among the ancient world and the earth that heaven was the place where order was managed, especially the place where the remnants of the lich were.
That's right, it's someone's masterpiece.
One day, a group of people quickly approached the direction of heaven.
These people are all strong and strong, and their bodies are extremely strong.
Especially the leader, who is nine feet tall, and every inch of his skin is shimmering with mysterious lines. If you look carefully, you can see that some kind of great law is inscribed on the body.
He held a large ax and a huge shield in each hand, and he looked powerful, as if the God of War had come to this world.
It is the remnant of the Wu clan who was once famous and one of the protagonists of the previous generation's calamity.
A wizard from the rear looked up at the sky and then at his companions around him. A trace of hesitation appeared on his face, and he finally couldn't help but speak:
"Brother Xingtian, is there something wrong with us coming to attack Heavenly Court today?"
When Xing Tian heard this, he frowned immediately.
The lich managed to survive the calamity, the witch clan was almost extinct, and all twelve ancestral witches perished. This was the time to recuperate and recuperate, why didn't he know?
But he heard the news that Haotian, the boy of Zixiao Palace, was established as the new Emperor of Heaven. If that's all, that's fine. The Wu clan has always had nothing to do with the Heavenly Court, and the Heavenly Emperor doesn't care about them at all.
But Haotian actually said that heaven is the place where order is managed in the ancient world. Doesn't that mean that heaven will rule the entire prehistoric world?
How can this be done? Where to put the Witch Clan?
So Xing Tian didn't stop and immediately led people to attack. One wants to occupy the heaven and find a suitable place for the Wu clan to recuperate.
The second is to revive the reputation of the witch clan. He wants all sentient beings to know that the Witch Clan has not truly perished!
Everything he Xingtian did was for the Wu clan.
Unexpectedly, there are still people who have doubts about this.
However, there were not many Wu clan left, so he did not get angry and just asked: "Uncle Feng, what's wrong?"
Uncle Feng is also one of the great witches of the Wu Clan, but his combat power is far inferior to that of Xing Tian. He bit the bullet and said: "The twelve ancestral witches have died, and the strongest person in the witch clan now is you, the great witch. If another accident happens to you, where will the witch clan go from here?"
Furthermore, Haotian was granted the title by Daozu Hongjun himself, so it would be wrong to attack rashly.
In my opinion, we should go to the Netherworld first and ask the Tuzu shaman what he wants before making further calculations. "
This was very reasonable, and several great witches nearby nodded in agreement.
The twelve ancestral witches are dead. If something happens to Xingtian again, what hope does the witch clan have? I'm just afraid that the day of destruction is just around the corner.
Besides, Haotian was ordered by Hongjun to come to the Great Wilderness. If he was killed by them, wouldn't he be offending the Taoist ancestors? Everyone really didn't want to attack Heaven.
Seeing how worried everyone was, Xing Tian couldn't help but sneer.
"That little boy from Haotian, who is just a mere boy, dares to sit on the throne of the Emperor of Heaven? What a big joke!" His voice was like a loud bell, which made the space buzz. "I think that the demon tribe was destroyed by my Witch Clan, and the Heavenly Court should be ruled by the Witch Clan. If Hongjun hadn't personally ordered it, how could it be his turn to take advantage? Heavenly Court belongs to the Witch Clan!"
In fact, this is not only Xingtian's idea, but also the voice of all sentient beings in the wild.
Why is the position in heaven so important? All forces covet him, and they all want to dominate the ancient world and become the emperor of heaven.
The three clans of Dragon, Phoenix and Qilin, the two Lich clans, and even the Duke of the East all fought and fought for it at the cost of their wealth and lives. But what about Haotian? He didn't do anything, just relied on a piece of imperial edict from Dao Ancestor to sit in the supreme position. How can there be no ideas in everyone's mind?
It's just that all living beings are afraid of the power of Taoist Hongjun and dare not act rashly.
The people of the Wu tribe naturally understand this truth. But how can things be so simple?
"The great witch must not underestimate Haotian and Yaochi." Uncle Feng said again, "Since they are Hongjun boys, they have some abilities. According to rumors, Hongjun once gave the two treasures, which are extremely powerful and must be guarded against."
